titulo: Shark catch-and-kill order issued after swimmer dies off popular Perth beach
cuerpo: Man, 63, fatally bitten by shark at Sorrento beach on Friday morning Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A shark that fatally attacked a man on a beach in Perth’s north will be “destroyed” if it is captured, after an order was issued by the Western Australian government. As the hunt for the animal remained under way on Saturday, the WA fisheries minister, Jackie Jarvis, revealed she had greenlit the order. Continue reading...
